_comment: Curated video layer. Add a video by pasting its URL into the list in scripts/add-videos.mjs and running that script — it fills in title, channel and thumbnail from YouTube's keyless oEmbed endpoint. Never edit title/author/thumb by hand; they are refreshed from oEmbed on every run. 'covers' lists the ids of globe events this video talks about, which is what makes the cross-reference clickable in both directions.

videos.title: What They Never Tell You About the Picts
videos.author: A History of Peoples
videos.placeNote: Pinned at Dunnichen in Angus, the likely site of the Battle of Dun Nechtain in 685 — the victory that stopped Northumbrian expansion and kept Pictland independent. The Picts were a people rather than a place, so any single pin is a convenience; this is the spot where their history turns.
